Address these bottlenecks by pushing for autonomous "tiger teams" and launching a low-risk, headless quoting pilot.
tasks: Finalize the competitive analysis presentation snippet for the Suhas management meeting.
Evaluate leadership incentive structures to align performance with AI adoption goals.
Pilot a low-risk, AI-enabled headless quoting capability to demonstrate rapid value.
Prepare talking points on transitioning to high-autonomy tiger teams.
